text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! W-Wasn't she incredible?
That tiny girl!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm-hmm! That late surge was insane, right?! What was their name again—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the grand stage of a GⅠ race,
Narita Taishin delivered an outstanding result!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The way the public looks at her seems to be gradually changing, too...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I mean, the next one is the real deal, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"The first race of the Triple Crown route, the Satsuki Sho.
...I will definitely claim it!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Narita Taishin, whose fighting spirit blazed bright,
our days preparing for the Satsuki Sho finally began...!
